stem:
The manager of a tire store asked customers how many miles they drove last week. The histogram shows the data collected.

Miles Driven Last Week

Based on the histogram, which statement must be true?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of customers who drove 150 miles or more is the same as the number of customers who drove less than 150 miles.

options.label: B
options.text: More customers drove 50 miles than drove any other distance.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of customers who drove 50 to 99 miles is less than the number of customers who drove 200 miles or more.

options.label: D
options.text: More customers drove 30 miles than drove any other distance.

visual_elements: Histogram titled 'Miles Driven Last Week' showing number of customers for distance ranges 0-49, 50-99, 100-149, 150-199, and ≥200.
